title: Act: Add HeaderOverlay and compose it in App
summary: Create the header and wire App to it and the store
description: Create HeaderOverlay and replace the loose RoundBadge/Countdown in App, moving the contribution sheet flag to the store and tracking the round error.
acceptance_criteria: App uses it and the store modal flag

steps.action: Create component rendering a header (absolute top-0 inset-x-0 z-10 flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-1 text-sm) with a Lucide BookOpen icon plus text 'StoryForge', worldName, round?.id, <RoundBadge status={round?.status}/> when round exists, <Countdown endsAt={round.ends_at}/> when round exists, and when !round && error a span role='alert' with the error text; add a button aria-label 'Toggle sound' with aria-pressed={soundEnabled} calling toggleSound (Volume2 or VolumeX icon) and a button aria-label 'Settings' calling setSettingsOpen(true) (Settings icon); wrap in motion.header with initial {opacity:0} animate {opacity:1}

Replace useState sheetOpen with useUiStore modal/openModal/closeModal (open when modal === 'contribution'); add useState roundError set in the getCurrentRound catch to the Error message; remove the inline RoundBadge and Countdown from the scene fragment and render <HeaderOverlay worldName={game.scene.title} round={round} error={roundError} /> first in the scene; Suggest button onClick openModal('contribution'); ContributionSheet onClose closeModal
steps.expected: App shows the header and opens the sheet via the store
